terraesf[l1_, l2_] := For[i = l1, i <= l2, i++, 
     esf[[i]] = (d[[l2]] - d[[l1]])^2/(8*r0) - 
        ((d[[i]] - d[[l1]]) - (d[[l2]] - d[[l1]])/2)^2/(2*r0); 
      h[[i]] = esf[[i]] + hin[[i]]; perfesfer[[i]] = {d[[i]]/km, esf[[i]]}; 
      perfpercur[[i]] = {d[[i]]/km, h[[i]]}]

atenua\[CCedilla]\[ATilde]o[l1_, l2_, \[Lambda]0_, h1_, h2_] := 
    Module[{i, aob, v, hh, vob}, For[i = l1 + 1; aob = 0; lob = 1; v = -0.78, 
       i < l2, i++, hh = (h1 - ((d[[i]] - d[[l1]])/(d[[l2]] - d[[l1]]))*
            (h1 - h2)) - h[[i]]; 
        vob = (-hh)*Sqrt[2*((d[[l2]] - d[[l1]])/((\[Lambda]0*(d[[i]] - 
                d[[l1]]))*(d[[l2]] - d[[i]])))]; If[vob > v, 
         aob = 6.9 + 20*Log[10, Sqrt[(vob - 0.1)^2 + 1] + vob - 0.1]; 
          lob = i; v = vob]]; aob]

aten526[ll1_, ll2_] := Module[{j, ap, aob}, lp1 = 1; lp2 = 1; lp = 1; 
      For[j = 1, j <= numfreq, j++, aob = atenua\[CCedilla]\[ATilde]o[ll1, 
          ll2, \[Lambda][[j]], h1, h2]; If[aob == 0, aobst[[j]] = 0, 
         ap = aob; lp = lob; a1 = atenua\[CCedilla]\[ATilde]o[ll1, lp, 
            \[Lambda][[j]], h1, h[[lp]]]; lp1 = lob; 
          a2 = atenua\[CCedilla]\[ATilde]o[lp, ll2, \[Lambda][[j]], h[[lp]], 
            h2]; lp2 = lob; t = If[ap <= 6, ap/6, 1]; 
          c = 8 + 0.04*(d[[l]]/km); aobst[[j]] = ap + t*(a1 + a2 + c)]]; 
      aobst]

atendeygout[lll11_, lll22_, rep_] := Module[{i, j}, 
     For[j = 1, j <= numfreq, j++, Clear[aten]; atenua = 0; 
        aten[l1_, l2_] := Module[{ll1, ll2, lpp}, 
          h1 = If[l1 == 1, h[[1]] + hae, h[[l1]]]; 
           h2 = If[l2 == l, h[[l]] + har, h[[l2]]]; If[rep != 0, 
            For[i = 1, i <= passivo, i++, h1 = If[l1 == pontospassivo[[i]], 
                h[[l1]] + hemipassivo[[i]], h1]; h2 = If[l2 == pontospassivo[[
                  i]], h[[l2]] + hrecpassivo[[i]], h2]]]; ll2 = l2; ll1 = l1; 
           aob = atenua\[CCedilla]\[ATilde]o[ll1, ll2, \[Lambda][[j]], h1, 
             h2]; lpp = lob; If[aob == 0, ll1 = ll2 = 1, 
            atenua = atenua + aob]; aten[ll1, ll2] = aten[ll1, lpp] + 
             aten[lpp, ll2]; atenua]; aten[1, 1] = 0; 
        aobst[[j]] = aten[lll11, lll22]]; aobst]

aten[l1$_, l2$_] := Module[{ll1$, ll2$, lpp$}, 
     h1 = If[l1$ == 1, h[[1]] + hae, h[[l1$]]]; 
      h2 = If[l2$ == l, h[[l]] + har, h[[l2$]]]; 
      If[0 != 0, For[i$4861 = 1, i$4861 <= passivo, i$4861++, 
        h1 = If[l1$ == pontospassivo[[i$4861]], h[[l1$]] + 
            hemipassivo[[i$4861]], h1]; 
         h2 = If[l2$ == pontospassivo[[i$4861]], h[[l2$]] + 
            hrecpassivo[[i$4861]], h2]]]; ll2$ = l2$; ll1$ = l1$; 
      aob = atenua\[CCedilla]\[ATilde]o[ll1$, ll2$, \[Lambda][[j$4861]], h1, 
        h2]; lpp$ = lob; If[aob == 0, ll1$ = ll2$ = 1, 
       atenua = atenua + aob]; aten[ll1$, ll2$] = aten[ll1$, lpp$] + 
        aten[lpp$, ll2$]; atenua]

elipfresnel[\[Lambda]0_, l1_, l2_, hemi_, hrec_] := 
    (Clear[fresnelup, fresnellow]; fresnelup = Table[{0.}, {i, l2 - l1 + 1}]; 
     fresnellow = Table[{0.}, {i, l2 - l1 + 1}]; For[i = l1, i <= l2, i++, 
      nfresn = 1; fresup = (h[[l1]] + hemi - ((d[[i]] - d[[l1]])/
            (d[[l2]] - d[[l1]]))*(h[[l1]] + hemi - h[[l2]] - hrec)) + 
         Sqrt[(nfresn*((d[[i]] - d[[l1]])*((d[[l2]] - d[[i]])/
              (d[[l2]] - d[[l1]]))))*\[Lambda]0]; 
       freslow = (h[[l1]] + hemi - ((d[[i]] - d[[l1]])/(d[[l2]] - d[[l1]]))*
           (h[[l1]] + hemi - h[[l2]] - hrec)) - 
         Sqrt[(nfresn*((d[[i]] - d[[l1]])*((d[[l2]] - d[[i]])/
              (d[[l2]] - d[[l1]]))))*\[Lambda]0]; fresnelup[[i - l1 + 1]] = 
        {d[[i]]/km, fresup}; fresnellow[[i - l1 + 1]] = {d[[i]]/km, freslow}])

atenuacaoespacolivre[f0_, l1_, l2_] := 
    32.44778 + 20*Log[10, (d[[l2]] - d[[l1]])/km] + 20*Log[10, f0]

pontovisivel[ponto_, h1_, h2_, l1_, l2_] := (visi1 = True; j = l1; 
     While[visi1 && j < ponto, 
      visi1 = If[h1 + href[[l1]] - ((d2[[j]] - d2[[l1]])/(d2[[ponto]] - 
              d2[[l1]]))*(h1 + href[[l1]] - href[[ponto]]) < href[[j]], 
         False, visi1]; j++]; If[visi1, visi2 = True; j2 = ponto; 
       While[visi2 && j2 < l2, 
        visi2 = If[href[[ponto]] - ((d2[[j2]] - d2[[ponto]])/(d2[[l2]] - 
                d2[[ponto]]))*(href[[ponto]] - href[[l2]] - h2) < href[[j2]], 
           False, visi2]; j2++]]; visi1 && visi2)

\[Alpha]\[Alpha][jj1_] := ArcTan[(href[[p1[jj1]]] + ha1[jj1] - 
       href[[p2[jj1]]] - ha2[jj1])/(d2[[p2[jj1]]] - d2[[p1[jj1]]])]
 
hluis[x_, x1_, x2_] := href[[x1]] - ((d2[[x]] - d2[[x1]])/
       (d2[[x2]] - d2[[x1]]))*(href[[x1]] - href[[x2]])
 
g[u_] := ((t/(8*Sqrt[Pi]))*((1 + u*(rr - 1))/(u^2*(1 - u)^2)))*
     Exp[(-(t^2/16))*(rr/(1 - u) - 1/u)^2]
 
t = -7.218465667437522
 
rr = -0.03888662318534113
 
ga[\[Theta]a_, raio_] := (x = ((2*Pi)*(raio/\[Lambda][[freq]]))*
       Sin[\[Theta]a]; 2*(BesselJ[1, x]/x))
 
gr[\[Theta]r_, aeff_] := (x = (Pi*(Sqrt[aeff]/\[Lambda][[freq]]))*
       Sin[\[Theta]r]; Sin[x]/x)
 
pspd[u1_, u2_, gre_, grr_] := NIntegrate[(gre*grr)*g[uu], {uu, u1, u2}]
 
\[Theta]1[x_, tro\[CCedilla]o_] := 
    ArcTan[(href[[p1[tro\[CCedilla]o]]] + ha1[tro\[CCedilla]o] - href[[x]])/
       (d2[[x]] - d2[[p1[tro\[CCedilla]o]]])] - \[Alpha]\[Alpha][
      tro\[CCedilla]o]
 
\[Theta]2[x_, tro\[CCedilla]o_] := 
    ArcTan[(href[[p2[tro\[CCedilla]o]]] + ha2[tro\[CCedilla]o] - href[[x]])/
       (d2[[p2[tro\[CCedilla]o]]] - d2[[x]])] + \[Alpha]\[Alpha][
      tro\[CCedilla]o]

esrcn[cn_] := Module[{Murber, murber, mrrber, Prber, sesr, mabs, \[Alpha]33, 
      esr}, Murber = cn - CNrber; murber = 10^(Murber/10); 
      mrrber = 1/(1/murber + 1/Ms); Prber = kt[]/mrrber; sesr = sesrcn[cn]; 
      mabs = Abs[Log[10, rber/berSESR[]]/Log[10, Prber/sesr]]; 
      \[Alpha]33 = 1; esr = sesr*nn[]^(1/mabs) + (nn[]*Nb[])*
         (rber/\[Alpha]33)]
